name: Shattered Window

stealth.note: (trained) to notice cracks spider-webbing across the window

description: The anger trapped within a structure shatters a window, showering glass in adjacent spaces.
disable: DC 19 Occultism check or DC 19 Religion check (trained) to suppress the spiritual energy or DC 20 Diplomacy check (trained) to soothe the latent anger

offensiveAbilities.name: Shatter
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the window

Effect The window shatters, dealing 2d6+5 slashing damage to creatures within 5 feet (DC 17 basic Reflex save).
